modules.name: Project Governance, Bootstrap & Consent
modules.objective: Maintain project identity, governance, consent gates and evidence-backed state.
boundaries: Product implementation requires explicit owner consent
No fabricated progress or timestamps
update_notes: Child identity may be initialized before product implementation; product development remains separately consent-gated.

modules.name: Desktop Audio Core & Virtual Devices
modules.objective: Provide low-latency microphone/speaker capture and virtual audio routing for calling applications.
boundaries: Native driver implementation requires approved technology stack

modules.name: Realtime Audio Enhancement
modules.objective: Improve realtime speech clarity before transmission or downstream AI.
boundaries: Must support provider adapters and future VSN models

modules.name: Accent Conversion & Voice Preservation
modules.objective: Convert accents in realtime while preserving speaker identity, intent and natural delivery.
boundaries: Accent conversion is not language translation
Initial commercial path may use verified external providers; proprietary VSN runtime is an optional later provider, not a hard dependency
update_notes: Dependency on MOD-011 removed so third-party/hybrid accent conversion can ship before proprietary model R&D.

modules.name: Realtime Speech Translation
modules.objective: Provide bidirectional realtime speech translation with appropriate voice/tone preservation.
boundaries: Translation latency and quality are evaluated separately from accent conversion

modules.name: Live Transcription, Captions & Diarization
modules.objective: Create accurate live/final speaker-aware transcripts for captions and downstream intelligence.
boundaries: Live transcript is provisional and must reconcile with final output

modules.name: Meeting Capture & Platform Connectors
modules.objective: Capture authorized meeting media, transcripts and metadata across major platforms.
boundaries: Recording/transcription requires authorized access and applicable consent

modules.name: Meeting Intelligence & Knowledge
modules.objective: Turn individual meetings into traceable notes and work products.
boundaries: Generated conclusions must remain traceable to source transcript evidence

modules.name: Live AI Assistant & Communication Coach
modules.objective: Provide opt-in realtime communication assistance without disrupting base call audio.
boundaries: Action execution belongs to MOD-024
No covert autonomous impersonation

modules.name: Hybrid AI Provider Gateway & Orchestration
modules.objective: Expose provider-neutral capability contracts over external AI providers and VSN-owned models.
boundaries: A provider is active only after access and implementation are verified
update_notes: All relevant usable third-party APIs/SDKs and VSN AI plug into this common layer.

modules.name: Proprietary VSN AI Runtime & Model Registry
modules.objective: Train, evaluate, package and version VSN-owned speech/audio models as first-class providers.
boundaries: Model training requires approved data rights, compute budget and explicit authorization

modules.name: Voice Personalization, Identity Safety & Voice Security
modules.objective: Support safe personalization and detect voice spoofing or identity misuse.
boundaries: No unauthorized voice cloning or impersonation

modules.name: Telephony & Contact Center Integrations
modules.objective: Extend realtime voice and intelligence capabilities to telephony/contact-center media.
boundaries: Integrations only where legally and contractually authorized

modules.name: SaaS Web App, Accounts, Teams & Workspace
modules.objective: Provide user/team accounts, settings and the conversation workspace.
boundaries: Implementation stack requires technology approval

modules.name: Subscriptions, Entitlements & Usage Metering
modules.objective: Operate subscription plans, quotas and accurate variable-AI usage metering.
boundaries: Raw card data remains with compliant payment provider

modules.name: Admin, Analytics, Observability & Cost Control
modules.objective: Measure and operate product/provider health, latency, quality, usage and cost.
boundaries: Sensitive audio/meeting content must not leak into telemetry

modules.name: Privacy, Security, Compliance & Data Governance
modules.objective: Govern audio, voice identity, transcripts, meetings, credentials and tenant data safely.
boundaries: Compliance claims require evidence

modules.name: Quality, Performance, Release & Desktop Updates
modules.objective: Verify quality/performance and safely package, release, update and roll back the product.
boundaries: No production release without verified QA/security evidence
update_notes: Repository-level ANPOS CI baseline can be activated before product implementation; product release work remains not started.

modules.name: Public Developer API, SDKs & Webhooks
modules.objective: Expose stable, secure and metered product capabilities to external developers.
boundaries: Only stable capabilities with approved security may be public

modules.name: Multi-Platform Clients & In-Person Capture
modules.objective: Extend Voice AI to mobile, browser and in-person capture surfaces.
boundaries: Respect platform permissions/background execution and recording consent

modules.name: Business Integrations & Workflow Automation
modules.objective: Connect conversation outcomes to calendars, email, chat, CRM, documents and work systems.
boundaries: Use only authorized scopes and verified external capabilities
Integration foundation must not depend on agentic action execution
update_notes: Removed MOD-024 hard dependency to eliminate circular dependency. Integration foundation feeds MOD-023 and MOD-024.

modules.name: Conversation Intelligence, QA & Compliance Scoring
modules.objective: Provide configurable B2B conversation analytics, QA and compliance workflows.
boundaries: Scores must be explainable and high-stakes decisions require human oversight

modules.name: Unified Conversation Knowledge & Cross-App Search
modules.objective: Create permission-aware search and Q&A across conversations and connected work systems.
boundaries: Retrieval must inherit source permissions and answers must cite evidence

modules.name: Agentic Actions, AI Skills & Voice Agents
modules.objective: Execute safe user-authorized follow-up work through reusable skills and specialist agents.
boundaries: No covert impersonation
Sensitive actions require scoped authorization/approval
update_notes: Dependency direction is now MOD-021 -> MOD-023 -> MOD-024; no circular dependency.

modules.name: Enterprise Administration, Device Fleet & Deployment Control
modules.objective: Support enterprise identity, fleet, policy and managed deployment at scale.
boundaries: Enterprise policy cannot bypass legal/user consent requirements
